periods.description: A major wealthy family and conglomerate connected to the Royal Officer Academy through Relie and Philuffy.
periods.history: The Aingram family had ties to the old imperial court before the coup; Philuffy was once selected for imperial human experiments, and Relie pleaded for her release.
periods.goals: Protect family interests, support academy operations, and maintain influence in the New Kingdom.
periods.structure: Relie is the elder daughter and academy headmistress; Philuffy is the second daughter and a student Divine Drag-Ride user.
